steps: Open a synthetic JSON document containing s\u0072c and a legacy local SVG reference; enter edit mode.
Observe automatic preview and natural image size 64x48.
Replace the draft with {, observe editable dirty text and the previous loaded image. Server metrics confirm one parser response with HTTP 400.
Replace with a valid text-only JSON object; the preview becomes hidden.
Restore escaped media syntax with changed note, observe preview, save and return to reading.
Reload the page; the saved note and media remain in the accessibility tree. Independently verify source bytes, registry, media hash, index reference and workspace.
observations: An optional image-dimension locator after page reload timed out although the fresh accessibility tree showed the saved note and image. Initial image decoding was measured successfully; post-reload decoding is not claimed.
The first independent checksum check used the wrong registry field; the final check correctly reads content.sha256 and passes.
limitations: Browser smoke covers JSON and SVG; YAML/YML, audio element identity, selection and pause behavior are covered by controller/HTTP tests, not real playback.
No Tauri native window or external-device test.
